title: Identification of Crucial Genes and Related Transcription Factors in Ulcerative Colitis.
authors: Ding, Hao; Liu, Xiao-Chang; Jian-Ming, Xu; Qiao, Mei
journal: Annals of clinical and laboratory science
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析溃疡性结肠炎差异表达基因并预测调控这些基因的转录因子，但仅基于表达数据和网络预测，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方法不匹配。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic, relapsing, and non-specific inflammatory bowel disease. To date, the pathogenesis of UC has not been fully understood. This study aimed to identify crucial genes and related transcription factors in UC by bioinformatic methods. METHODS: Datasets GSE75214 and GSE48958 were used to identify the common differentially expressed genes (DEGs). GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses were performed using the STRING database. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed to screen hub genes using the STRING database and Cytoscape software. The expressions of the identified hub genes were verified using dataset GSE73661, and their correlations with Mayo scores were analyzed using dataset GSE92415. The transcriptional factor (TF) regulatory network of the hubgenes was constructed by Network Analyst. RESULTS: A total of 147 common DEGs, including 114 up-regulated and 33 down-regulated genes, were screened out, among which CXCL9, TIMP1, PTGS2, ICAM1, CXCL1, MMP9, IL1B, CXCL8, and IL6 were identified as hub genes with high degrees in the PPI network. Correlation analysis showed that the expressions of these hub genes were significantly correlated with Mayo scores in UC patients. Finally, RELA, FLI1, and BACH1 were predicted to be the key TFs regulating these nine hub genes. CONCLUSIONS: This study systematically analyzed the differential gene expression pattern and associated key TFs in UC, which may provide new insights into the pathogenesis and offer opportunities for discovering novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets for UC.
abstract_zh: 目的：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种慢性、复发性、非特异性炎症性肠病。迄今为止，UC的发病机制尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在通过生物信息学方法识别UC中的关键基因及相关转录因子。方法：利用数据集GSE75214和GSE48958鉴定共同的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。使用STRING数据库进行GO和KEGG通路富集分析。通过STRING数据库和Cytoscape软件构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络以筛选枢纽基因。使用数据集GSE73661验证所识别枢纽基因的表达，并利用数据集GSE92415分析其与Mayo评分的相关性。通过Network Analyst构建枢纽基因的转录因子（transcription factor, TF）调控网络。结果：共筛选出147个共同DEGs，包括114个上调基因和33个下调基因，其中CXCL9、TIMP1、PTGS2、ICAM1、CXCL1、MMP9、IL1B、CXCL8和IL6被鉴定为PPI网络中高度连接的枢纽基因。相关性分析显示，这些枢纽基因的表达与UC患者的Mayo评分显著相关。最后，预测RELA、FLI1和BACH1为调控这九个枢纽基因的关键转录因子。结论：本研究系统分析了UC中的差异基因表达模式及相关关键转录因子，这可能为UC的发病机制提供新见解，并为发现新的生物标志物和治疗靶点提供机会。
